verdict.rationale: Google's docs show real controls: users can review and delete Gemini Apps activity and turn off 'Keep Activity' in My Activity (gemini-docs-31), and can control whether audio/video from Gemini Live is used to improve models (gemini-docs-37), with defaults stating chats/files aren't used to improve models absent opt-in (gemini-docs-38). This covers activity history and model-training data use, but there's no evidence of a general telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out (e.g., diagnostic/usage analytics beyond chat history) or independent confirmation that these settings work as described. Missing for 10: a documented full telemetry/analytics opt-out beyond chat history, and independent/hands-on verification that toggling these settings actually stops tracking.
